scope: All 51 timed trials in three separate measured stages, plus correctness, negative outcomes and supporting evidence.
identity_preserved: Numeric values, source commits, image/source/fixture hashes, record fingerprints and original audit input hashes are unchanged.
original_hash_semantics: canonical_* fields hash original local bytes; publication_* fields hash normalized publication bytes. Private path keys may differ. The manifest itself is excluded.
omitted: built images, caches and build contexts
